records.title: Post decompression shock (a case report)

records.exposure_date_locator: Case History, p. 10, and next-day assessment on p. 12
records.extraction_method: Firecrawl OCR followed by visual verification against the original numbered pages.
records.evidence_note: The model uses the existing review observation for one case. The scan on p. 10 dates the chamber test 5 June 1957. The 6 June entry on p. 12 is the first documented asymptomatic examination. Hospital discharge recorded DCS. The proposed pulmonary vascular mechanism was unconfirmed.
